scope: Safe supplier settlement retirement and local payable reservation completion domain

redTest.cause: All terminal ERP rejections were initially treated as proof allowing replacement; ALREADY_SETTLED signals a possible settlement for the same bank payment and must block replacement

verified: Never-dispatched queue and read-only claim must stop before retirement
Unknown, pending, dispatched NOT_FOUND and ALREADY_SETTLED cannot retire
Independent finance decision binds original settlement, bank identity and revision
Only exact confirmed ERP settlement can complete the original local reservation
Completion and lifecycle release are mutually exclusive
Original source and historical hold remain immutable
Old JSON without settlement field remains readable through procurement, bank and HTTP regression
limitations: Database storage and atomic local reservation completion still require the next migration and service change
No public settlement or retirement endpoint is exposed yet
Runtime remains V72 with no real ERP settlement
